003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import java.awt.Color;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.PersonAPI;

012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Ranks;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;

019
020public class AngryVIPTransport extends HubMissionWithBarEvent {
021
022        public static float MISSION_DAYS = 75f;
023        public static int MIN_VALUE = 24000;
024        public static int MAX_VALUE = 36000;
025        
026        public static enum Stage {
027                TRANSPORT,
028                COMPLETED,
029                FAILED,
030        }
031        
032        protected MarketAPI sourceMarket;
033        //protected StarSystemAPI destination_system;
034        protected MarketAPI destination_market;
035        protected int quantity;
036        protected String destinationId;
037        protected Variation variation;
038        protected PersonAPI person;
039                
040        @Override
041        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
042                // if already accepted by the player, abort
043                if (!setGlobalReference("$avipt_ref", "$avipt_inProgress")) {
044                        return false;
045                }
046                
047                if (createdAt == null) return false;
048                
049                if (Factions.PIRATES.equals(createdAt.getFaction().getId())) return false; // I guess?
050                
051                sourceMarket = createdAt;
052                
053                // whitelist of aristocrat-plausible core worlds.
054                String[] planet_whitelist = new String[] {
055                                "eventide",
056                                "kazeron",
057                                "fikenhild", 
058                                "culann_starforge",
059                                "eochu_bres",
060                                "eldfell",
061                                "salamanca",
062                                "yesod", 
063                                "olinadu",
064                                "station_tse_enterprise",
065                                "coatl" };
066                
067                List<String> withoutSource = new ArrayList<String>();
068                for (String curr : planet_whitelist) withoutSource.add(curr);
069                
070                // if the source market isn't one of these, bail out
071                if (!withoutSource.remove(sourceMarket.getId())) {
072                        return false;
073                }
074                
075                destinationId = pickOne(withoutSource);
076                if (destinationId == null) {
077                        Global.getLogger(AngryVIPTransport.class).info("AVIPT failed on destinationId");
078                        return false;
079                }
080                
081                //sourceMarket.getFaction().createRandomPerson();
082                //PersonAPI person = sourceMarket.getFaction().createRandomPerson();
083                setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
084                setGiverPost(Ranks.ARISTOCRAT);
085                setGiverVoice(Voices.ARISTO);
086                findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
087                
088                
089                person = getPerson();
090                if (person == null) {
091                        return false;
092                }
093                
094                // This is to stop Fortuna Kato from embarassing herself. -dgb
095                // And then added a special tag for this sort of thing. -dgb
096                if(     person.hasTag(Tags.NO_RANDOM_MISSIONS) ||
097                        person.getRank().equals(Ranks.HOUSE_LEADER_FEMALE) || 
098                        person.getRank().equals(Ranks.HOUSE_LEADER_MALE) || 
099                        person.getRank().equals(Ranks.HOUSE_LEADER))
100                        return false;
101                
102                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$avipt_ref")) {
103                        return false;
104                }
105                
106                setRepFactionChangesNone();
107                setIconName("campaignMissions", "shuttle_vip");
108                
109                destination_market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(destinationId);
110                
111                if (!setMarketMissionRef(destination_market, "$avipt_ref")) {
112                        return false;
113                }
114                
115                makeImportant(destination_market, "$avipt_target", Stage.TRANSPORT);
116                addSuccessStages(Stage.COMPLETED);
117                
118                setStartingStage(Stage.TRANSPORT);
119                setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
120                setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
121                
122                setStageOnMemoryFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, destination_market, "$avipt_completed");
123                setNoAbandon();
124                setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, null);
125                
126                
127                setCreditReward(MIN_VALUE, MAX_VALUE);
128                
129                return true;
130        }
131        
132        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
133
134                set("$avipt_barEvent", isBarEvent());
135                set("$avipt_reward", Misc.getWithDGS(getCreditsReward()));
136                set("$avipt_timelimit", Misc.getWithDGS(MISSION_DAYS));
137                set("$avipt_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
138                set("$avipt_heOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe());
139                set("$avipt_hisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer());
140                set("$avipt_himOrHer", getPerson().getHimOrHer());
141                set("$avipt_HeOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(1));
142                set("$avipt_HisOrHer", getPerson().getHisOrHer().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHisOrHer().substring(1));
143                set("$avipt_HimOrHer", getPerson().getHimOrHer().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHimOrHer().substring(1));
144                
145                set("$avipt_personName", getPerson().getNameString());
146                set("$avipt_systemName", destination_market.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort());
147                set("$avipt_marketName", destination_market.getName());
148                set("$avipt_sourceName", sourceMarket.getName());
149                
150                //if (destination_entity.m)
151                //set("$lpt_marketOnOrAt", destination_entity.getOnOrAt());
152                
153                set("$avipt_dist", getDistanceLY(destination_market));
154        }
155        
156        @Override
157        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
158                float opad = 10f;
159                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
160                if (currentStage == Stage.TRANSPORT) {
161                        info.addPara("Transport an angry, yet wealthy, VIP to " + destination_market.getName() + 
162                                        " in the " +  destination_market.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort() + ".", opad,
163                                        h, Misc.getWithDGS(quantity));
164                        
165                        info.addPara("The VIP has made it clear that " + getPerson().getHeOrShe() + " is to arrive within " + MISSION_DAYS + " days.", opad);
166                }
167        }
168
169        @Override
170        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
171                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
172                if (currentStage == Stage.TRANSPORT) {
173                        info.addPara("Transport an angry, yet wealthy, VIP to " + destination_market.getName() + 
174                                        " in the " +  destination_market.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort(), pad, tc,
175                                        h, Misc.getWithDGS(quantity));
176                        return true;
177                }
178                return false;
179        }       
180        
181        @Override
182        public String getBaseName() {
183                return "Angry VIP Transport";
184        }
185        
186}
